detail: Forensic glass classification (type) by 9 oxide measurements; each fragment one row, no grouping factor.
Two-way rat-genotype layout (litter genotype x foster-mother genotype, 4 levels each); both are treatment factors, Wt is a litter-average weight gain, no clustering.
Old Faithful eruption durations and waiting times, a sequence of 299 eruptions; two continuous columns, no grouping factor.
Soil line-transect, 365 locations; pH, conductivity and chloride at three depths stored wide across columns, all numeric, no grouping column.
35 Scottish hill races, time ~ dist + climb regression; each race one row, no grouping factor.
Copenhagen housing-satisfaction frequency table; Sat (ordinal) by Infl/Type/Cont fitted with fixed polr/multinom/Poisson models, cross-classified, no grouping factor.
33 leukaemia patients, coxph(Surv(time) ~ ag + log(wbc)); ag a binary covariate, each patient one row, no clustering.
Aggregated binomial regression cbind(Menarche, Total-Menarche) ~ Age over 25 age groups; one row per age group, Age a continuous covariate, no grouping factor.
Minnesota 1938 graduates four-way contingency table (hs, phs, fol, sex) with frequencies; cross-classified, no grouping factor.
Accelerated life test, survreg/coxph(Surv(time, cens) ~ temp); temp a covariate, no motorette id column, no grouping factor.
104 oil wells with x/y coordinates, porosity and permeability; spatial, each well one row, no grouping column.
54 painters scored on four characteristics within 8 schools (School a possible grouping); the help page gives no model and names no single response (PCA/correspondence context).
School-absenteeism counts, glm.nb(Days ~ Eth*Sex*Age*Lrn); children cross-classified by four covariates, no clustering.
Road-accident deaths for 26 US states, one row per state, deaths ~ covariates regression; no grouping factor.
Rotifer fall-out binomial data for two species stored wide (pm.*, kc.*); response split across columns, no grouping column.
Ship-damage aggregate counts cross-classified by type/year/period with offset log(service); documented fixed Poisson GLM (McCullagh & Nelder 6.3.2), no random grouping factor named.
Autolander decision (use) by six categorical condition factors, 256 cross-classified rows; a classification problem, no grouping factor.
Snail-mortality binomial completely randomised design, cbind(Deaths, N-Deaths) ~ Species/Exposure/Rel.Hum/Temp; aggregated cells, no random grouping factor.
Stormer viscometer nonlinear calibration Time = B1*Viscosity/(Wt-B2); 23 single observations, no grouping or replication structure.
237 Adelaide students survey, cross-sectional; no grouping factor and no documented model.
Ripley's synthetic classification problem; synthetic (simulated) two-class data, the test set.
Ripley's synthetic classification problem; synthetic (simulated) two-class data, the training set.
52 topographic height points with x/y coordinates; spatial, no grouping column.
Site-by-species wader-count matrix (15 sites, 19 species columns) for correspondence analysis; no grouping column and no single response.
One house's weekly gas consumption, lm(Gas ~ Insul*Temp) before/after insulation; Insul a covariate, single house, no clustering.
One obese patient's weight at 52 time points, nonlinear growth curve nls(Weight ~ b0 + b1*2^(-Days/th)); single subject, no grouping.
